- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of recipe ideas categorized into One-Pot Wonders, 30-Minute Meals, Pantry Staples, and Meal Prep Ideas.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] One-Pot Wonders: 
  1. Chicken Fajita Pasta: Cook pasta, chicken, bell peppers, onions, and fajita seasoning in one pot.
  2. Quick Chicken and Rice: Cook chicken, rice, and favorite vegetables in a flavorful broth.
  3. Lentil Soup: Sauté onions, garlic, and carrots, then add lentils, broth, and diced tomatoes.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] 30-Minute Meals:
  1. Taco Night: Use pre-cooked ground beef, shredded cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes.
  2. Omelette with Veggies: Whip up an omelette with eggs, shredded cheese, and favorite vegetables.
  3. Baked Chicken and Veggies: Season chicken breasts and bake with roasted vegetables.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Pantry Staples:
  1. Grilled Cheese and Tomato Sandwich: A classic comfort food.
  2. Spaghetti with Marinara and Veggies: Cook spaghetti, heat marinara sauce, and add sautéed vegetables.
  3. Black Bean and Corn Tacos: Use canned black beans, frozen corn, and taco seasoning.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Meal Prep Ideas:
  1. Slow Cooker Chili: Cook chili in a slow cooker with ground beef, beans, and vegetables.
  2. Roasted Chicken and Veggies: Roast a whole chicken with vegetables.
  3. Mason Jar Salads: Prep salads by layering greens, vegetables, and proteins in mason jars.
